meta.name: YouTube增强
meta.argumentsDesc:
- 屏蔽参数：[true, false] 
- 翻译参数：[语言代码, off] 

1. 语言代码遵循 Google Translate Languages Codes, 当填入 off 时关闭翻译
2. 开启调试模式用于输出更多日志

script.8: ScriptDef { name: "youtube.response", path: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Maasea/sgmodule/master/Script/Youtube/youtube.response.js", kind: HttpResponse, pattern: Some("^https:\\/\\/youtubei\\.googleapis\\.com\\/(youtubei\\/v1\\/(browse|next|player|search|reel\\/reel_watch_sequence|guide|account\\/get_setting|get_watch|log_event|config))(\\?(.*))?$"), conditions: HeadConditionsDef { request: None, response: None }, requires_body: true, binary_body: true, max_size: 0, cronexp: "", event: "", timeout: None, argument: Some(String("{\"captionLang\":\"off\",\"blockUpload\":true,\"blockImmersive\":true,\"blockShorts\":true,\"debug\":false}")) }
